text:
Predicates:
RomanceLanguage(x) ::: x is a Romance language.
IndoEuropeanLanguage(x) ::: x is an Indo-European language.
LanguageFamily(x) ::: x is a language family.
WithinFamily(y, x) ::: y is within language family x.
Related(x, y) ::: x is related to y.
French(y) ::: y is French.
Spanish(y) ::: y is Spanish.
German(y) ::: y is German.
Basque(y) ::: y is Basque.
NotRelated(x, y) ::: x is not related to y.
Premises:
∀x (RomanceLanguage(x) → IndoEuropeanLanguage(x)) ::: All Romance languages are Indo-European languages.
RomanceLanguage(RomanceLanguages) ::: The Romance languages are a language family.
∀x (WithinFamily(y, x) ∧ RomanceLanguage(y) → Related(x, y)) ::: All languages within a Romance language family are related to each other.
French ∈ RomanceLanguages ::: French is a Romance language.
Spanish ∈ RomanceLanguages ::: Spanish is a Romance language.
Related(German, Spanish) ::: German is related to Spanish.
NotRelated(Basque, y) ::: Basque is not related to any other language y.
Conclusion:
¬RomanceLanguage(German) ::: German is not a Romance language.
